labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: Rich strips carriage returns by design; Live display is the documented way to update a line in place.

body:
Rich removes carriage returns from text it prints, so `\r` does not move the cursor back to overwrite the line the way the built-in `print()` does. To update a line in place, use the live display instead: [live.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) covers `Live`, and `Progress` uses the same mechanism for progress bars.

For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
